name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

eligibility.other_conditions: Individual must have a savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent enabled.

benefits: Life insurance coverage of Rs 2 Lakh payable to the designated nominee in case of death of the insured member due to any cause (natural or accidental) at an annual premium of Rs 436.
application_process: Enroll through participating bank branch or internet banking portal.
Submit nomination and consent for auto-debit of Rs 436 annual premium.
Insurance certificate generated and linked to Aadhaar.
